description: I smell gas in my kitchen near the stove, it's been getting stronger for the last hour.
notes: Emergency override case: gas leak keyword should force urgency=emergency regardless of LLM output.

description: There's water pouring out of the ceiling in my living room and it's spreading fast, please help now.
No heat at all since last night, it's below freezing outside and my kids are cold.
notes: Emergency override case: no heat during freezing weather.

description: I saw sparks coming out of the outlet in my bedroom when I plugged in my lamp.
Part of my bedroom ceiling collapsed last night, there's debris on the floor and a hole above my bed.
My kitchen sink is dripping slowly, it's been like this for a couple weeks.
The dishwasher isn't draining properly, water pools at the bottom after a cycle.
There's a mouse problem in my apartment, I've seen droppings in the cabinets.
My front door lock is jammed and I can't get it to turn, I'm stuck outside right now.
notes: Clean but time-sensitive, not a hardcoded emergency category.

description: The bathroom light has been flickering and the outlet nearby is also loose, and honestly the toilet's been running non-stop too.
expected_missing_information: Is the loose outlet sparking or hot to the touch?
Is the running toilet also leaking onto the floor?
notes: Ambiguous/multi-issue case: electrical + plumbing mentioned together, needs clarification on severity of each.

description: Something's wrong with my apartment, it's been bothering me for days and I just want someone to look at it.
expected_missing_information: Where in the apartment is the issue located?
notes: Missing-information case: vague complaint with no actionable detail.

description: The AC unit is making a loud rattling noise and it doesn't seem to be cooling as well as before.
My upstairs neighbor's tub overflowed and now there's a wet stain spreading on my ceiling, it looks like it could give way.
expected_missing_information: Is water actively dripping through, or just a stain?
Has the ceiling started to sag or crack?
notes: Ambiguous case: could escalate to structural/emergency depending on missing details, good test of confidence calibration.

description: I've called about the same leaking pipe under my sink twice now and it's still not fixed, water is pooling again.
notes: Recurring-issue/failed-fix case: same property/unit as case_06, relevant for Phase 6 retrieval testing later, and should raise urgency due to repeat failure.

description: There's a weird smell in the hallway outside my unit and also my smoke detector keeps chirping, not sure if related.
expected_missing_information: Can you describe the smell (gas, smoke, burning, musty)?
Is the smoke detector chirping due to low battery or an actual alarm?
notes: Ambiguous, potentially safety-critical case: worth checking whether classifier appropriately flags for review rather than guessing, given proximity to gas/fire keywords without a clear match.
